channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff ramps up traffic enforcement with summer crackdown on speeders
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies and launching a new targeting initiative aimed at reducing speeding and reckless driving across the county. item.title: Argentina rallies past England with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two goals in the final five minutes to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals Wednesday, advancing to face Spain in Sunday's final.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday as President Trump plans attendance
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies continue with a two-year security plan for Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey as President Trump attends the trophy presentation.

item.title: World Cup final tickets cost more than average monthly US household income
item.description: The cheapest ticket for Sunday's World Cup final on resale sites is about $7,700, nearly identical to what the median U.S. household earns in an entire month.

item.title: Lionel Messi bathed Spain's Lamine Yamal as baby in 2007 photo shoot before Sunday's World Cup final
item.description: Photographer Joan Monfort's 2007 photos of teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal have gone viral before Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain.

item.title: World Cup boosts beer sales 14 percent in U.S. host cities during tournament
item.description: Beer sales in bars, restaurants, stadiums and other venues rose 14 percent in U.S. host cities during the first four weeks of the World Cup compared to the same period last year.

item.title: Treasure Coast gymnasts from Flip City qualify for Junior Olympics after top 15 national finish
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying them for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Palm Beach Zoo extends Kids Free promotion through Aug. 10 and announces Wild Night Out adults-only events
item.description: Palm Beach Zoo extended its Kids Free promotion and announced the return of its Wild Night Out series on the last Saturdays of July, August and September.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to 1,250 children at 35 summer sites
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach is providing thousands of free meals to children through Florida's Summer BreakSpot program while school is out for the summer.

item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa discounts for July and August
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority launched a mobile-exclusive Wellness Pass offering free fitness classes, yoga sessions, spa discounts and wellness promotions from participating businesses.

item.title: Orlando fentanyl summit draws teens, grieving parents and DEA chief as crisis takes center stage
item.description: Teens from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined grieving parents and federal law enforcement at the Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando this week, united by a mission to stop fentanyl before it kills more Americans. item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs Blue Angels low-altitude Pensacola flyover as safety reviews draw scrutiny
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is encouraging low-altitude military flyovers after a Blue Angels jet buzzed a crowded Pensacola beach this week, sending chairs and tents flying.

item.title: Murray Middle School demolition begins in Martin County after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Demolition is underway at Murray Middle School in Martin County, starting a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage from Hurricane Milton.

item.title: Fort Pierce woman turns $20 scratch-off into $5 million lottery jackpot
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, claimed a $5 million top prize from the Florida Lottery after purchasing her winning ticket at a Fort Pierce convenience store.

item.title: JetBlue ending direct flights from Vero Beach to JFK Airport in September
item.description: JetBlue is ending its direct flights between New York's JFK Airport and Vero Beach Regional Airport, citing low passenger demand for the route that launched in December.
